newsitem.title: MALTA: New Malta investment fund launched.
newsitem.headline: New Malta investment fund launched.

text.p: VALLETTA , Feb 5 (Reuter ) - Tri-Med Fund Management Ltd on Wednesday announced it was launching its first fund, the Tri-Med Malta Accumulator Fund SICAV.
The investment objective of the fund is to achieve capital growth by investing in income-generated securities and other assets denominated in Maltese lira.
Any income earned by the fund will be re-invested in securities and assets. The fund will not distribute income, but investors will be able to sell any part or all of their holding at any time.

Tri-Med said the fund did not have any initial charge and investors would only be charged an exit fee of one percent of the net asset value of any sale or transfer of units. The annual management fee has been set at 0.75 percent per annum of the FundOs NAV..
The minimum investment has initially been set at Lm100,000 but this is expected to be reviewed shortly, when a lower limit will be set.
The fund will be listed on the Malta Stock Exchange.
Tri-Med was set up in October between Mid-Med Bank (49 percent) Deutsche Fonds Holding GmbH (41 percent) and APS Bank Limited (10 percent).
